# dsh-wsl-download
> **Install set:** part of dsh-wsl-kit.
Tool **`win_download`**: `list`/`copy` Windows Downloads into WSL, or `hint` for ModelScope/HF/GGUF/
Flash-Next playbooks (no network; skip re-downloading existing shards).
中文说明 → README.zh.md
## Where it sits
Lists or copies Windows Downloads, and hints ModelScope / Hugging Face / GGUF paths. It does not sta
rt a download by itself.
